score:calv.notes: All four named files are present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), with the run's scripts beside them. The output files the memo's Appendix C names as on disk (analysis_out.txt, phrase_census_out.txt, reading_ledger.tsv, build_report.txt, scope_docs.tsv, scope_sections.tsv, texts/) are absent from the calv directory as supplied, so "kept on disk" could not be confirmed; the scripts' paths point at a run folder I was told not to read. The memo pastes the two analysis outputs and the build report in full, and I scored P6 on that. Verification done against the index and the bundled JSON: coverage and both controls re-run (553|321749|1103|8481; 312,169; 552 with frus1919Parisv05 the exception; 0); the 62-section field rebuilt from Appendix A through volume_structures reproduced 1,667 documents in 38 volumes, the 40,177 denominator, the source-row figures (1,578; RG 59 1,570; decimal era 1,559 dated from 1910-08 plus 10 frus1907p2 numerical-file citations; 14 with no parsed class; 89 without a source row, 79 of them 1895-1904), the country counts (233/197/185/106/83/80/79/68), the external-citation figures (56 documents, 65 citations, all centralFileClass, earliest 1921-01-28, 817.00 x11/824.00 x7/816.01 x6), the decade table and the six lots in frus1950v02; all 53 quotations of M5 are raw substrings of body_text and the 18 overview quotations are among them; the 56 argument documents exist, are non-apparatus, carry the stated lengths, numbers and datelines, and include no Ed2 volume; the JSON resolutions hold (64D563 -> NAID 1136548 A1 558-D, 12 claimant series, M862 series 654171 with the four rolls, 11 of 698 series starting before 1940, LBJ-NSF 567979, RN-NSF 572235, POL 16 labelled in the 1963 schedule only, 1,079 citations in 465 classes, 12 citations of 7 lot/library targets, 33,554 centralDecimalFile notes). Observations recorded in the evidence that did not change a verdict: the memo names two Ed2 volumes where the index holds three (frus1977-80v09Ed2 unnamed) and did not state an Ed2 check for its one corpus-wide published figure (28 documents in 18 volumes), which I verified is clean; two exploratory frus1923v01 searches (log lines 62-63) returned zero rows and are unreported, with no claim resting on them; M2.4 restates decade rates without their denominators at that point (they stand in M2.1's pasted table); extcit_scope.py and usage_scope.py outputs are recorded in the memo rather than as files. The session opened no vector artifact, so V1-V6 are not_applicable, which the rubric says is the correct verdict and a finding about the appendix as a front door. Compliance = 34/34 of the applicable items.
